standard.name: FRS 102 The Financial Reporting Standard applicable in the UK and Republic of Ireland - Section 1A Small Entities

version.label: FRS 102 Section 1A small entity - engineering draft 0.1 (unverified)

source.provision: FRS 102 Section 1A and Sections 11, 17, 23, 29; SI 2008/409 Sch 1 (format 1 balance sheet and profit and loss account, notes); Companies Act 2006 ss.411, 413, 414, 415-419, 475-477. Drafted, not retrieved: check every rule against the current text

version.notes: Engineering draft (DEC-064). Balance sheet and profit and loss account in format 1 as engineering understands it. Prepayments sit within debtors and accruals within creditors. Investments, share premium, the revaluation reserve, distribution costs and provisions for liabilities have no V1 reporting line: place those accounts with company overrides. Retained earnings and dividends accounts map to other reserves in this draft; the verifier should decide their presentation. Amendments effective for periods beginning on or after 1 January 2026 have not been checked.

rules.title: Statement of compliance
rules.body: These financial statements have been prepared in accordance with FRS 102 The Financial Reporting Standard applicable in the UK and Republic of Ireland, including the provisions of Section 1A Small Entities, and the Companies Act 2006.
rules.verifierNote: Check the compliance wording expected for a small entity applying Section 1A.

rules.title: Basis of preparation
rules.body: The financial statements have been prepared under the historical cost convention. They are presented in pounds sterling.
rules.verifierNote: Adjust if assets are revalued or the presentation currency is not sterling (the platform keeps exact pence).

rules.title: Going concern
rules.body: {{fact:text.goingConcern}}
rules.verifierNote: The directors' assessment is company-specific wording entered as text.goingConcern.

rules.title: Turnover
rules.body: Turnover represents amounts receivable for goods and services provided in the normal course of business, net of discounts and value added tax. Turnover from the sale of goods is recognised when the significant risks and rewards of ownership have passed to the buyer; turnover from services is recognised as the services are performed.
rules.verifierNote: Generic wording; tailor to the business. Check against any amendments to Section 23 effective for the period.

rules.title: Tangible fixed assets
rules.body:
Tangible fixed assets are stated at cost less accumulated depreciation and any accumulated impairment losses. Depreciation is charged so as to write off the cost of assets, less their residual values, over their estimated useful lives, on the following bases:
{{fact:text.depreciationRates}}
rules.verifierNote: The rates per class come from text.depreciationRates; they should agree with the fixed-asset register's classes.

rules.title: Financial instruments
rules.body: The company has only basic financial instruments. Trade and other debtors and creditors, cash and bank balances, and loans are measured at transaction price and subsequently at amortised cost.
rules.verifierNote: Only right where the company has no other financial instruments (Section 12). Check the measurement wording, including for loans on non-market terms.

rules.title: Taxation
rules.body: The tax charge comprises current tax and deferred tax. Current tax is the tax payable on the taxable profit for the year. Deferred tax is recognised on timing differences between the treatment of items in the financial statements and their treatment for tax purposes.
rules.verifierNote: Generic wording; check deferred tax recognition and measurement wording.

rules.title: Employees
rules.body: The average number of persons employed by the company (including directors) during the year was {{fact:employees.average}} ({{year:priorEnd}}: {{fact:employees.averagePrior}}).
rules.verifierNote: Confirm whether directors are included in the count.

rules.title: Tangible fixed assets
rules.body: {{table:fixedAssets.movements}}
rules.source: SI 2008/409 Sch 1 (fixed assets: movements in cost and depreciation); FRS 102 1AC
rules.verifierNote: The movement table is drawn from the ledger by fixed-asset class. Check whether comparatives for the reconciliation are required.

rules.title: Provisions for liabilities
rules.body: {{table:provisions.movements}}
rules.verifierNote: Check the disclosure level required for a small entity.

Amounts falling due after more than one year: {{line:B.CA1}} ({{year:priorEnd}}: {{line:B.CA1:prior}}).
{{fact:text.securedDebts}}

{{fact:text.directorAdvanceTerms}}

rules.title: Directors' report
rules.body: The directors present their report and the financial statements for the year ended {{year:end}}.
rules.verifierNote: Introductory sentence; not itself a requirement.

rules.title: Directors
rules.body: The directors who held office during the year were {{directors:names}}.
rules.verifierNote: Names of persons who were directors at any time during the year.

rules.title: Small companies exemption
rules.body: This report has been prepared in accordance with the provisions applicable to companies entitled to the small companies exemption.
rules.verifierNote: Statement required where the report is prepared taking advantage of the small companies exemption.

rules.title: Approval of the directors' report
rules.body:
This report was approved by the board of directors on {{fact:approval.date}} and signed on its behalf by:
{{fact:approval.director}}, Director
rules.verifierNote: Approval by the board and signature by a director or the secretary.

rules.title: Audit exemption
rules.body:
For the year ending {{year:end}} the company was entitled to exemption from audit under section 477 of the Companies Act 2006 relating to small companies.
The members have not required the company to obtain an audit of its accounts for the year in question in accordance with section 476.
The directors acknowledge their responsibilities for complying with the requirements of the Act with respect to accounting records and the preparation of accounts.
rules.verifierNote: Only where the audit exemption is taken; remove for audited companies.

rules.title: Small companies regime
rules.body: These financial statements have been prepared in accordance with the provisions applicable to companies subject to the small companies regime.
rules.verifierNote: Statement above the director's signature on the balance sheet.

rules.title: Approval
rules.body:
The financial statements were approved by the board of directors on {{fact:approval.date}} and signed on its behalf by:
{{fact:approval.director}}, Director
rules.verifierNote: Approval by the board and signature by a director on the balance sheet.
